Job Title: Analyst CEO Office
Location: London
Location type: Hybrid

Who we are
GlobalData operates an intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change. By uniting proprietary data, human expertise and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organisations see what's coming, move faster and lead with confidence. Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organisations across the world's largest industries.

Why join GlobalData?
GlobalData is at a pivotal point in its growth journey and needs curious, ambitious, courageous people. Life at GlobalData is fast paced, entrepreneurial and rewarding.

The role
The Analyst works directly alongside senior leads within the CEO Office to drive high-priority corporate initiatives, structure operational workflows, and execute strategic and commercial programmes. This role is an accelerated entry-level path for analytical, high-energy graduates who excel at deconstructing complex problems, building scalable business playbooks, and synthesising performance data into actionable executive insights.

What you'll be doing
• Quantitative Analysis & Insights: collect, clean and model operational and financial data to identify business trends, evaluate project ROI, and deliver actionable performance conclusions to leadership.
• Operating Playbooks & Process Design: partner with divisional teams to document core business processes, structure repeatable standard operating procedures (SOPs), and build operational playbooks for enterprise scaling.
• Executive Programme Support: work closely with CEO office leads to track project milestones, coordinate cross-functional workstreams, and resolve operational bottlenecks.
• Executive Reporting & Presentations: build clear, highly structured slide presentations, automated dashboards and weekly status summaries for the CEO Office and executive leadership.
• Ad-Hoc Strategic Problem Solving: support fast-turnaround research, competitor benchmarking, customer churn analysis, and AI/automation pilot tracking.

What we're looking for
• Recent bachelor's or master's graduate in Business, Economics, STEM, Finance, or a related analytical discipline.
• Exceptional numerical literacy and structured problem-solving skills; advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with SQL, Tableau, or Power BI is an advantage.
• High degree of intellectual curiosity, comfort navigating ambiguity, and a bias toward action.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to synthesise dense data into clear takeaways.
• Proven ability to manage competing priorities, balance detail-orientation with speed, and collaborate across diverse teams.

GlobalData offers benefits across health, finances, fitness, travel and tech; see careers.globaldata.com. GlobalData is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Salary: £40,000 - £45,000 (employer provided on Glassdoor)

jd_full:
About IWSR
IWSR is the global authority on beverage alcohol data and intelligence, now part of WGSN. For over 50 years the world's leading drinks businesses have used our data to plan their strategy and investment. We combine our own long-run market data, consumer insight and data science with on-the-ground intelligence in more than 160 markets.

About the Role
We're looking for a Data Analyst Intern to join our Data Ingestion team for 12 months, starting on 12 January 2027. You'll work closely with one of our Data Analysts, helping process and check the data that goes into IWSR's Global Database.
Much of the work is repetitive, and we want to be upfront about that. It suits someone who wants to learn how a global data product is built, takes pride in accuracy and isn't afraid to ask questions.

What You'll Do
• Process and ingest incoming data into the Global Database using our tools and workflows
• Run quality checks on country and global data, especially during busy periods
• Complete data entry requests from our Market Analysts accurately and on time
• Triage incoming requests and keep trackers up to date
• Flag anything that doesn't look right
• Help write and update process notes for the team

What We're Looking For
• A real appetite to learn and the confidence to ask questions
• Someone proactive and enthusiastic who stays focused through repetitive work
• Strong attention to detail
• Good numeracy and confidence in Excel
• Clear written and spoken English

Nice to Have
• An interest in data or the drinks industry
• More advanced Excel, such as lookups and pivot tables
• Some exposure to SQL or Python

Experience
This is an entry-level role. A degree in a numerate or analytical subject is preferred, but we don't expect previous data experience. Study, projects or part-time work that show accuracy and a willingness to learn all count.

Benefits: In addition to a competitive salary, IWSR offers
• Generous time off: 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and a company-wide end-of-year break.
• Flexible work environment: Hybrid working model with flexible hours.
• Comprehensive perks: Annual bonus scheme, pension, regular social events, and a volunteering policy.
• Growth opportunities: Lots of learning and development opportunities

At Wolfspeed, we believe the most powerful innovations are created by people who care deeply about what they build and why it matters. As the leader in silicon carbide technology, we are enabling a more sustainable, electrified future, one breakthrough at a time.

In your role as a Junior Business Operations Analyst, you will support the day-to-day operations of the Enterprise Applications function, working closely with project managers, business analysts, application specialists, and team leaders. You will help coordinate projects, maintain documentation, support communications, facilitate collaboration, and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
• Support team with coordinating project activities, milestones, and deliverables.
• Organize meetings, prepare agendas, capture minutes, and track actions through to completion.
• Maintain project documentation, status reports, risk and issue logs, and team trackers.
• Assist with preparing presentations, reports, and stakeholder communications.
• Support business analysts in documenting business requirements, workflows and process improvements.
• Participate in workshops and meetings, capturing decisions, requirements, and actions.

This role may require additional duties and/or assignments as designated by management.

Required Qualifications
• Degree, diploma, or equivalent experience in Business, Information Technology, Information Systems, Management, Communications, or a related discipline.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across teams.

• Interest in technology, business processes, project delivery, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications
• Previous internship, placement, or early-career experience in project coordination, business analysis, technology, or business operations.

• Experience using collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Service Now, Microsoft Planner / Project, Smartsheets or similar platforms.

Data Governance Analyst - ghd (Leeds Office)
Operations | Full time | Permanent

WHO ARE WE?
Iconic British brand ghd is a global leader in premium professional hair styling tools and the UK's number one recommended styling brand.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
As a Data Governance Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and governance of commercial master data across ghd's global business systems.
Working closely with Product Development, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Commercial teams, you will maintain and govern data relating to materials, finished goods, product attributes, specifications and product hierarchies across Microsoft Dynamics, PLM and associated business systems.
You will act as a key custodian of product data, ensuring information is accurate, consistent, and available to support product launches, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, planning, procurement, reporting, and commercial decision-making.

LOCATION
This role will be based in our Leeds office, with a hybrid working pattern of 3 days in the office and 2 days WFH.

JOB ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Master Data Management & Governance:
• Create, maintain and govern product, material, component and finished goods master data within Microsoft Dynamics and associated systems.
• Ensure master data is accurate, consistent, complete and aligned with established governance standards and controls.
• Support new product introductions, product changes and end-of-life processes through effective master data management.
• Monitor and resolve data quality issues, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions where required.
• Support master data audits and compliance activities to ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
Data Analysis & Reporting:
• Produce reports and insights that support commercial decision-making, data governance initiatives and operational performance.
• Analyse data trends, identify anomalies, and provide recommendations to improve data quality and business processes.
• Utilise reporting and analytical tools to support ongoing business requirements.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Partner with Product, Procurement, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance and Commercial teams.
• Act as a subject matter expert for product and material master data processes.
• Provide support and guidance to stakeholders on master data standards and best practices.
• Facilitate alignment between business functions to ensure consistent data management practices globally.
Continuous Improvement:
• Identify opportunities to improve data governance, system processes and reporting capabilities.
• Support the development and implementation of data quality initiatives and process enhancements.
• Contribute to the evolution of master data management practices across the business.
Product Master Data Support:
• Provide ad hoc support for Product Master Data activities.
• Work with ghd's Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system to support data governance, alignment and cross-system data integrity.

REQUIREMENTS
• Experience working in a data, analytical, operations, finance, supply chain, or commercial support role.
• Strong attention to detail and a passion for working with accurate, high-quality data.
• Intermediate Excel skills and the confidence to analyse and manipulate data.
• Experience using business systems, databases, or ERP platforms.
• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills.
• Curiosity and initiative to identify improvements and challenge existing ways of working.
• Exposure to Power BI, Power Query, SQL, or master data management practices would be a plus.

VALUES
• Collaborative, Creative, Courageous, Connected.

Band 5 Data Co-ordinator - University Hospitals Birmingham NHS Foundation Trust
Closing date: 01 December 2026

Job summary
This is a new role in our People Directorate, created because we have identified an opportunity to strengthen how we use data, reporting and insight to support our people, our services and the decisions that affect patient care.
This role will support four key areas of the Directorate, helping us to better understand our workforce, plan effectively, identify trends, respond to risks and make sound, evidence-based decisions.
You will be central to the production of high-quality, timely and accurate people data reports. This will include routine and ad hoc reporting, dashboards, assurance reporting, committee reports and national submissions. The role will require someone who can work confidently across multiple workstreams, manage competing priorities and plan for key calendar events such as assurance meetings, committee cycles and national reporting deadlines.

Main duties of the job
You will work across four key areas: HealthCare Careers and Development, Workforce Planning and design, Employee Relations casework reporting, and Freedom to Speak Up. The information you work with will vary in nature and sensitivity, so the role needs someone who can handle information with care, confidentiality and professional judgement.
This is a visible role, working closely with the Workforce Information Manager and supporting senior leadership teams with the information they need to make informed decisions.
We are looking for someone who is organised, analytical and confident turning information into clear, reliable reporting, with strong analytical skills, sound judgement, excellent attention to detail and the ability to translate complex information into accessible reports.

Details
Date posted: 23 November 2026
Pay scheme: Agenda for change, Band 5
Salary: £32,073 to £39,043 a year

As a Payments Service Management Analyst, you'll help keep some of Nationwide's most important payment services running safely and reliably for our customers.

You'll work within Electronic Payments in either Faster Payments and Open Banking or Bacs and Current Account Switching. You'll help monitor service performance, investigate issues, understand risks and make sure actions are followed through with the right teams.

Holland & Barrett is the largest health & wellness retailer in Europe. As a Commercial Analyst in the Core Business Analytics team, you'll help Commercial and Trading teams make more impactful decisions through a clear understanding of our competitive position and the performance of our pricing and promotions strategy. • Visualisation skills: Builds intuitive dashboards in Metabase.
• Analytical thinking and experimentation: Can assess the impact of pricing or promotional trials using appropriate benchmarks and test-and-control comparisons.

Senior Researcher and Analyst (Fieldwork) - TONIC Research Consultancy
The TONIC team is part of a research consortium conducting a multi-year independent evaluation of Healthy Babies on behalf of the Department for Health and Social Care (DHSC). Healthy Babies is a government programme in England supporting families during pregnancy and the first two years of a child's life.
Your primary responsibility would be conducting in-person qualitative fieldwork with parents, carers and families in different local authority areas across England.

Responsibilities
• Conducting sensitive, ethical and trauma-informed qualitative fieldwork, primarily in-person interviews and focus groups with parents, carers and families
• Building trust and rapport with research participants; maintaining professional boundaries and following safeguarding procedures
• Travelling to local authority areas across England (two to four days on site per visit)
• Organising and coordinating fieldwork: scheduling interviews, liaising with participants and local contacts
• Supporting recruitment and engagement of research participants
• Collecting, managing and analysing qualitative data and identifying emerging themes
• Contributing to written reports and research outputs
• Working collaboratively with researchers, analysts and colleagues

Qualifications
• Degree in a relevant discipline with a social research methods element, or equivalent professional experience

Experience
• Conducting qualitative research interviews and/or focus groups, including fieldwork independently
• Working or conducting research with parents, carers, children and families, particularly those experiencing disadvantage
• Building rapport with people from a wide range of backgrounds
• Working in sensitive or challenging environments
• Organising and delivering fieldwork, managing appointments, working independently
• Analysing qualitative data and contributing to findings or reports
• Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
Advantageous: children's services, early years, public health or social care; local authorities, NHS or charities; participatory research; SmartSurvey, Quirkos, DisplayR; large-scale or longitudinal evaluations.

Skills: interpersonal skills; compassionate, non-judgemental approach; confident independent interviewing; organisation; written communication; flexibility and frequent travel. A full UK driving licence and access to a car are essential.

Job type: full-time (36 hours), 24-month fixed-term contract, with potential to become permanent.
Start date: January/February 2027.
Working pattern: predominantly home-based with regular in-person fieldwork across England, some evenings or weekends; team meets monthly in central London.
Salary: £34,000 starting salary. 35 days annual leave plus bank holidays, pension, funded training.
Application: complete TONIC's application form (SmartSurvey link in the advert) explaining your interest and how you meet the person specification. Interviews early to mid-December 2026 via Teams.
Offer conditional on BPSS screening (identity, right to work, three-year history, basic criminal record check) and an enhanced DBS check.

Competencies
Customer Focus; Driving Change; Driving Results; Embraces Diversity; Enterprise Leadership; Judgement and Decision Making; Risk Management; Strategic and Visionary; Trust and Integrity

CUSTOMER & MARKET INSIGHT ANALYST
Odevo UK - Competitive - Hybrid - London
ROLE OVERVIEW
You will join Odevo UK as a commercially minded analyst who can turn complex data, customer insight and market intelligence into clear, actionable stories. This is a role for someone who enjoys asking smart questions, exploring patterns and trends, and helping others make better decisions with confidence. Your work will directly support strategic thinking, commercial priorities and growth by bringing together robust analysis with a sharp understanding of customers, competitors and the wider market.
You will blend quantitative analysis with primary and secondary research, using modern analytics and AI-enabled tools to uncover insight that matters. From identifying market shifts and competitor activity to shaping recommendations that influence leadership discussions, you will play a visible role in how we understand our market and where we go next.
ROLE EXPECTATIONS
Most days, you will be gathering, analysing and interpreting data from a range of internal and external sources, then turning that into concise insight for stakeholders across the business. You will move between research, reporting, competitor tracking and presenting findings.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
• You produce clear, relevant insight that helps stakeholders make better strategic and commercial decisions.
• You spot meaningful trends, risks and opportunities early, and communicate them in a way that drives action.
• You build trusted relationships with colleagues by translating complex data into simple, compelling narratives.
• You use research, analytics and AI tools effectively to improve speed, depth and quality of insight.
• You create outputs that are accurate, well-structured and tailored to the needs of different audiences.
• You bring a proactive mindset, regularly suggesting new angles, better methods and fresh opportunities for the business.
HOW YOU'LL SPEND MOST OF YOUR TIME
• Analysing customer, market and business data to identify trends, patterns and opportunities that support decision-making.
• Conducting primary and secondary research, including desk research, competitor analysis and market scanning.
• Turning findings into presentations, reports and summaries that make insight easy to understand and act on.
• Monitoring competitor activity, market developments and customer themes to keep the business informed and prepared.
• Using modern analytics and AI tools to improve research efficiency, deepen analysis and strengthen recommendations.
• Working with stakeholders across the business to understand priorities, refine questions and deliver insight that meets real commercial needs.
WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR
• You are a curious, self-starting analyst who enjoys exploring data, asking questions and finding the story behind the numbers.
• You are comfortable working independently, but you also value collaboration and know how to build credibility with a wide range of people.
• You think commercially and can connect research and analysis to practical business outcomes.
• You communicate clearly and confidently, tailoring your message so that different audiences can quickly understand the key point.
• You enjoy variety and are energised by a role that combines data analysis, market research and strategic insight.
EXPERIENCE THAT HELPS
• Experience in an insight, market research, strategy, commercial analysis or business intelligence role would be useful.
• Familiarity with combining quantitative analysis and qualitative or desk-based research would be valuable.
• Experience producing competitor intelligence, customer insight or market landscape analysis would help you get up to speed quickly.
• Confidence using data visualisation, analytics or AI-supported research tools would be an advantage.
• Experience presenting findings to stakeholders and influencing decisions through well-structured insight would be beneficial.
WHAT WE OFFER
• Competitive salary
• 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
• Salary sacrifice scheme and the option to buy annual leave
• Spectrum Life wellbeing platform
• Cycle to Work scheme
• Fully funded training and professional development
• Employee referral scheme, up to £1,500
ABOUT ODEVO UK
Odevo aims to become the leading international force in residential property management. In six years it has grown more than 70-fold, with more than 12,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico and Italy.
HOW WE HIRE
• Initial conversation with our talent team
• Interview focused on your analytical thinking, research approach, communication style and ability to turn insight into commercial recommendations
We aim to complete the process within two to three weeks.
INTERESTED?
Apply with your CV.
All applicants must be eligible to live and work in the UK. Documentary evidence of eligibility will be required.

Job title: Wealth Transformation Graduate
Department: Wealth Transformation, Wealth Management
Salary: £45,000
Start date: Thursday 16 September 2027
Location: City of London, London

About Schroders, our parent company
Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations.

Programme overview
Our two-year Wealth Transformation Graduate Programme offers a unique opportunity to gain broad experience across Business Transformation at one of the UK's leading and fastest growing wealth management businesses. You'll combine on-the-job experience with structured learning and development, including taking the Investment Advice Diploma (IAD), and opportunities to network across the business.
As part of the programme, you will undertake rotations within Wealth Transformation, gaining hands-on experience in the roles of Business Architecture, Strategic Design, Business Analysis and Project Management, with exposure across Client teams, Investment, Operations and key support functions.

Who we are looking for
• A strong interest in the transformation of a business to improve growth, efficiency and risk outcomes
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Collaborative and relationship-oriented
• Inquisitive and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in Wealth Management and relevant industry trends
• Innovative, analytical and able to apply critical thinking, particularly using AI
• Proactive, organised, and eager to get involved in a broad range of tasks, projects and teams
• Adaptable and resilient, able to manage multiple priorities
• A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and high attention to detail
• A growth mindset
• Eager to learn and develop, actively embracing feedback
• Problem solver able to get into the detail while managing the bigger picture

The Team
Schroders Wealth Transformation team has a remit across the transformation lifecycle from strategy to execution, working with business and technology partners to help the Cazenove Capital and Schroders International Wealth business grow, delivering transformational and essential change.

What you will do
• Project Management: collaborate with project teams and business stakeholders to deliver change initiatives on time and within budget; establish a critical path and deliverable plan, with clear communication and disciplined project governance.
• Business Analysis: act as a bridge between business needs and solutions, working with stakeholders to understand and articulate requirements, define target processes, and support the design and realisation of value-driven change.
• Business Architect: build knowledge of the business, strategic design and operating model, to support the design and delivery of transformation projects.

Qualifications required
• An honours degree or equivalent - open to all degree subjects and predicted grades
• You will be in your final year of study or have already graduated
No prior Change or Wealth Management experience is needed.

Benefits
• Professional qualifications: achieve the Investment Advice Diploma (IAD) in your first few weeks; opportunity for further qualifications
• Comprehensive training in industry knowledge, technical and soft skills
• Senior networking "Coffee Hours"
• Buddy system
• Employee Assistance Programme and private GP service
• On-site staff restaurant and gym

Recruitment process
• Online application form
• Stage 1 Cognitive Online Assessment
• Stage 2 Behavioural and Motivational Assessment
• Stage 3 Work Simulation and Video Interview
• Assessment centre
Candidates should be available to start on Thursday 16 September 2027.

We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are
Schroders is an equal opportunities employer and will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles.

Follow the stock. Find the difference. Keep global operations moving.

At TD SYNNEX, we are looking for an analytical and detail-focused Supply Chain Analyst to join our Global Operations team.

In this role, you'll help keep products, orders and inventory moving smoothly across our OEM business. You'll work with data from our systems and third-party warehouses, investigate differences, monitor stock and orders, and make sure issues are followed through to resolution.

This is a great role for someone who enjoys working with data, solving problems and figuring out why something doesn't match. You'll also support sales operations activities, giving you exposure to different parts of our global business.

You don't need to know every system or process from day one. We'll provide training and support as you learn.

Why You'll Love Working Here
• Private healthcare, matched pension, and enhanced parental and family leave
• "Moments that matter" paid time off
• Four Business Resource Groups supporting inclusion and belonging
• Clear progression paths and benchmarked salaries
• A strong commitment to sustainability
• A collaborative culture that values different perspectives
• Predominantly home-based working with flexibility around how you organise your day
• A friendly and experienced team to support your onboarding

Values: Own It; Grow and Win; Dare to Go; Do the Right Thing. Great Place to Work organisation and Disability Confident employer.

What You'll Be Doing
• Reconcile stock and transaction information between our internal systems and third-party warehouses.
• Investigate missing stock, incorrect quantities and other discrepancies, and follow issues through to resolution.
• Monitor inventory availability, open orders and order backlogs and identify where action is needed.
• Process and review orders and investigate orders that are delayed or stuck in internal systems.
• Support stock allocation, product movements and order prioritisation.
• Analyse operational data to identify trends, exceptions and potential issues.
• Work with colleagues, customers, suppliers, warehouses and logistics partners to resolve operational issues.
• Maintain accurate records and ensure actions are completed within agreed timelines.
• Support reporting and process improvements across the team.

What You'll Bring
• Strong Excel skills and confidence working with different sources of data.
• Strong numerical and analytical skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• A curious, problem-solving mindset.
• A structured and organised approach to managing your workload.
• Clear communication skills and confidence working with different stakeholders.
• The ability to work independently and take ownership of issues through to resolution.
• A willingness to learn new systems and processes.

Helpful, but not essential
• Experience in supply chain, inventory, order management or sales operations.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system.
• Experience with Excel functions such as lookups and pivot tables.

You don't need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you're analytical, accurate, curious and willing to learn.

At Shyft Global Services, a TD SYNNEX Company, our values guide everything we do.

What's In It For You?
• Elective benefits tailored to your country.
• Formal programmes on leadership and professional development, plus on-demand courses.
• Well-being seminars, events and a global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
• Onboarding network programme in your first 30 days.
• Business resource groups, volunteering events and environmental and social initiatives.

Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway. We are an equal opportunity employer.

jd_full:
About The Role
Associate Applications & Data Analyst
Location: Irthlingborough
Hours: 36.25 per week, Monday to Friday, 8:45am-5:00pm, excluding bank holidays.

We're improving the systems, data and IT services that support our business, and this role offers the opportunity to learn how they work together in a manufacturing environment. You'll help maintain accurate information in our ERP system, IFS, support colleagues with everyday system queries and develop your skills in data checking, reporting and wider IT support. Working alongside our Applications & Data Analyst and reporting to the Applications & Data Manager, you'll receive a structured training plan and practical guidance from experienced colleagues. As your confidence grows, you'll take on more work across IFS, SQL and Qlik reporting.

What are the main responsibilities of the job role:
• Creating and maintaining product, customer and supplier records in IFS, following agreed standards and procedures.
• Maintaining product structures, routings and packaging information.
• Supporting colleagues with day-to-day IFS queries and master data requests.
• Checking data for errors and inconsistencies, investigating straightforward issues and correcting them at source.
• Carrying out routine checks on reports and scheduled data updates, raising any failures or unexpected results.
• Learning to build and update SQL queries and Qlik reports with support from experienced colleagues.
• Making sure system changes are properly requested, approved and recorded.
• Helping with everyday IT support requests, including user accounts, devices, printing and access.
• Keeping procedures and user guides up to date and helping build shared knowledge across the business.
• Taking part in training and shadowing across applications and IT infrastructure.
• Exploring how AI and automation could improve data processes and reduce manual work.

This is an entry-level role that could suit a graduate, someone pursuing an apprenticeship, or someone looking to begin a career in systems and data. We don't expect you to arrive with experience in every area. Full training on IFS, Qlik and SQL will be provided, and your attention to detail, interest in technology and willingness to learn will be key.

What are the key ingredients needed for the role?
• Good Excel skills, including lookups, filters and pivot tables.
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
• A logical, methodical approach to checking information and solving problems.
• An interest in how business systems support manufacturing and day-to-day operations.
• Good communication skills and the confidence to help colleagues, ask questions and seek support when needed.
• The ability to follow procedures consistently and learn new systems.
• An awareness of confidentiality and the importance of protecting business information.
• A willingness to learn across both applications and wider IT support.
• GCSE English and Maths at grade 4/C or above, or equivalent.
• Experience with ERP systems, data administration, SQL, reporting tools or IT support would be beneficial, whether gained through work, study or a placement. A relevant degree, apprenticeship or training programme would also be useful, but a demonstrable interest in systems and data and a willingness to learn are more important.

What will help you succeed?
• You enjoy working with data and getting the details right.
• You're naturally curious about how systems and processes work.
• You're comfortable asking questions and checking your understanding.
• You take responsibility for your work and see tasks through.
• You can organise your workload and keep colleagues informed.
• You enjoy helping others and working as part of a team.
• You're open to learning across different areas of IT.
• You're keen to develop your technical skills and build your career.

Benefits
Exclusive High Street Discounts, Health & Wellbeing Support (healthcare advisors and professional counsellors), Exclusive Staff Shop.

About Us
We're on an exciting mission here at Whitworths - to help boost the nutrient intake of the nation, improving general health of families using the goodness found in our delicious products. You will receive a competitive salary, 33 days holiday, a workplace pension, and in addition, you'll also have access to a number of family friendly, health and lifestyle benefits. Culturally, we believe strongly in investing in our people, developing them in role and developing their careers within Whitworths, as demonstrated by our recent accreditation from Investors In People.

Overview
Calendar Club is Europe's biggest and best calendar store, stocking over 4,000 calendars, diaries and gifts online and in store every year. Between October and January, we have 220+ Calendar Club stores open over the UK and Ireland.
The Solutions department develops and maintains all the in-house applications and data reporting that is required in all aspects of the business including inventory control, store sales, EPOS and warehouse management.
We are looking for a Junior Solutions Analyst with good communication and problem-solving skills, excellent attention to detail and a willingness to learn. This junior development role provides practical experience in business analysis, report writing, software testing, application support and SQL Server administration. With training and mentoring, the successful candidate will develop the confidence to work independently and as part of a team.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Assist with gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Work with users to understand business processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Produce and maintain reports using SQL and Microsoft Excel.
• Analyse business data and investigate discrepancies or data quality issues.
• Support the creation of management information and KPI reporting.
• Assist with creating and maintaining test plans, test cases and test scripts, and execute tests for new developments, bug fixes and system enhancements.
• Record, prioritise and track software defects, incidents, service requests and enhancement requests. Support user acceptance testing and help validate that software changes meet agreed business requirements before release.
• Assist in producing release notes and deployment documentation.
• Provide first-line support for bespoke business applications; respond to helpdesk enquiries via email, telephone and ticketing systems.
• Explore and apply approved artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to improve efficiency, documentation, analysis, testing and problem resolution.
• Assist with setting up new users and maintaining application security, access and user permissions.
• Assist with the installation, configuration and updating of business applications under guidance.
• Provide support for EPOS systems and store operations as required.
• Participate in an on-call support rota during the peak trading season, including occasional Saturday cover.
• Monitor and maintain SQL Server jobs, backups and routine maintenance tasks.
• Support database administration and performance monitoring activities.
• Assist with data imports, exports and system integrations.
• Create and maintain user guides, knowledge base articles, support procedures, process documentation and technical documentation.

Requirements
Essential
• Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel.
• Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work with large volumes of data accurately.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to learn new technical concepts and business systems quickly.
• Strong organisational, administrative and time management skills.
• Ability to provide excellent customer service to internal users.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable
• Experience of writing SQL queries.
• Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio.
• Experience of report writing and data analysis.
• Understanding of software testing principles and methodologies.
• Experience using Power BI or similar reporting tools.
• Knowledge of SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
• Understanding of business process mapping or requirements gathering.
• Experience of supporting business applications or working in a helpdesk environment.
• Experience using ticketing or issue-tracking systems.
• Experience creating user guides, test plans or support documentation.
• Familiarity with EPOS systems or retail business applications.
• Knowledge of eCommerce platforms and websites.
• Familiarity with PowerShell, VBA or other scripting languages.

Pay: £28,000-£35,000 per year
Benefits: company pension, cycle to work scheme, employee discount, free flu jabs, free parking
Work Location: In person

HR Systems Analyst

• Strong numerical and analytical skills

Introduction
Since 1987, Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our industrial clients' capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. We guide our clients to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximise their performance across cost, schedule, safety, operability, and sustainability. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors.

The Organisations & Teams Research Analyst Role
The role sits within a rapidly growing area of the company in which we synthesise organisational expertise with our access to actual project data to advise our clients on individual, team, and organisational practices that affect capital project performance. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to lead the development of products & services, research, and consulting offerings for capital project organisations and teams. Primary responsibilities:
• Conducting analyses using predictive models to determine appropriate staffing benchmarks for project organisations and teams in various industries
• Developing reports and deliverables to present analysis results to clients
• Modifying, updating, and adding predictors to predictive staffing models, and conducting sensitivity analyses to ensure models are robust and reliable with the addition of global, cross-industry data
• Leveraging IPA data and designing research studies to address client questions and identify organisation and talent solutions for the capital projects industry
• Recommending appropriate statistical analysis techniques (e.g., multiple regression analysis, exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis) to explore research questions and test hypotheses
• Providing input into survey design for research studies
• Creating statistical models and analysis tools, and training others to use them effectively
The analyst will focus primarily on studies and client engagements related to capital project organisation design, staffing, team composition, and individual competency, collaborating with cross-functional groups and working directly with clients.

Core Qualifications
• Excellent analytical skills
• Proven ability to relate data and statistical analysis to real-world application
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Demonstrated capacity to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies
• Aptitude for learning new concepts and applying them quickly
• A track record of finding creative solutions to complex problems
• Comfort with ambiguity and flexibility in thought and/or approach
The successful candidate will work well in teams, but also be capable of managing multiple projects independently and have experience in applied research or consulting.

Education and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in industrial & organisational psychology, organisational development, organisational behaviour, economics, business analytics, or a related field, or a bachelor's degree in STEM or a related field (e.g., systems engineering)

• Private healthcare, dental and optical, employee assistance programme

How To Apply
Complete the application form and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

Discover your future at Citi
Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe.

Job Overview
Citi Markets Operations is currently at a pivotal point in its evolution and journey to implement a target operating model. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model.
We cover all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative & Commodities Operations, supporting Fixed Income, Equity and Syndicates products.
Our Operations groups partner with Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR, and with our external client base.
Our Business Intelligence and Process Re-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve operational challenges.
Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and continuously evaluate our controls.

Job Purpose
This is an exciting opportunity to kick start your career at Citi! We are looking for enthusiastic and energetic team players, with a strong work ethic, who will join Markets Operations.
This is a Senior Analyst, Reconciliations role within the Markets Operations Organisation, providing daily support to our Global Markets Businesses trading Over the Counter (OTC) derivative transactions.
This newly formed team helps to oversee the completeness of bookings, postings and flows across our Trading desks and Central Counterparty (CCP) clearing houses. The team is critical in completing daily reconciliations to ensure balances tie out and there are no breaks across the lifecycle of the trade.
We're seeking individuals with relevant experience, ideally in Finance. You will work closely with business partners and internal stakeholders to ensure all transactions flow through our front to back Operations teams, with no issues.
You will have the opportunity to recommend creative suggestions on how to improve processes to minimise losses from failed internal processes, inadequate controls and emerging risk.

Risk Management
• Executing critical core operations activities where processes, risks and controls are continually monitored, and potential risks escalated on a timely basis
• Analysis, escalation and resolution of breaks / risk with Senior Management
• Facilitating risk close out for market transactions
• Daily collaboration across Global Trading and Operations teams to provide solutions and identify/resolve root cause
• Acting as key point of contact for the team across internal and external stakeholders
• Identifying trends, synergies and weaknesses across products and regions
• Recommending control enhancements as needed

Organisational Transformation
• Providing input to simplify, improve and measure processes by delivering enhancements to the control environment and the trade journey, with input to design techniques and digital automation
• Providing input into strategic platform re-engineering initiatives, reducing manual touch points
• Providing input into initiatives to continuously improve straight through processing (STP) rates

Qualifications and Skills
• BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience
• Relevant experience in a Tier 1 global financial institution would be beneficial and/or experience in Market Operations, Derivatives, Reconciliations, Controls, Equities or Fixed Income
• Energetic, flexible, collaborative, and proactive
• Strong risk management and control mindset
• Self-reliant, good problem solver, results oriented
• Ability to establish and build trust with professionals throughout the business

Job Family: Securities and Derivatives Processing

About Precision Management Consulting
Precision Management Consulting helps small and medium sized businesses fix how they run. We use our 5M methodology: Map the business, Measure its numbers, Model the options, Modify how it operates and Maintain the results. Our clients are owner run businesses with messy data and real cash pressure. We help them understand where profit and cash are going and what to do about it.

The role
You will work on client engagements across all five Ms. The core of the job is financial analysis and financial modelling, supported by clear process modelling. You will turn a client's accounts, ledgers and operational data into a clear picture, then explain it simply to the business owner.

How you will work across the 5 Ms
Map: Understand how the client's business actually runs, from enquiry to cash.
• Draw swimlane and activity diagrams of the key processes
• Pull together data from accounting systems, CRMs and job records, and model how it connects
• Spot where work, time and money leak
Measure: Find out where profit and cash are going.
• Analyse profit and loss accounts, balance sheets and ledgers, including gross margins and overheads
• Link profit to cash: how debtors, creditors, VAT, loans and dividends move cash
• Reconcile ledgers to bank statements, flag discrepancies, and draw clear conclusions
Model: Show the client what could happen next.
• Build financial models and projections, including profit and loss and cash flow forecasts
• Test options such as pricing, headcount and collection of debtors
• Explain the assumptions in plain English
Modify: Change how the business operates, so the improvements are real.
• Turn the findings into action plans with owners and dates
• Manage the projects: monitor progress, follow up, and keep the client accountable
• Report on results and adjust the plan
Maintain: Keep the improvements in place.
• Prepare monthly management accounts and run reviews with the client
• Run variance analysis against the plan, track KPIs and update forecasts
• Coach the client to stay on track, and keep the models and process maps current
Across all five Ms, you will present findings to clients, guide them through next steps, and use AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to work faster, checking and explaining everything they produce.

What we are looking for
• A solid understanding of finance: double entry bookkeeping, gross margin, overheads, and how to read a profit and loss account and balance sheet
• Experience in financial analysis and building models in Excel
• Basic process modelling, including UML style swimlane or activity diagrams
• Experience managing projects: planning actions, monitoring progress and keeping to dates
• An excellent communication style: you can explain complex ideas in simple terms to people who are not finance specialists, in writing and live
• Hands on experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, and the ability to verify and explain what they produce
• Fluent business English, written and spoken

Nice to have
• An accounting or finance qualification, or study towards one
• Experience with Xero, QuickBooks or similar accounting systems
• Experience working with SMEs or in consulting

Ready for a challenge?
Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role
We're looking for a Mid-level Product Analyst / Analytics Engineer to join our analytics team, focused on our Post Order Help Experience. When something goes wrong with an order, more and more customers get help from our AI agentic chat, which understands their issue and resolves it end to end.
This is a genuinely hybrid role, split roughly evenly between analysis and analytics engineering. You'll measure whether our AI agents truly solve customers' problems and what that means for their trust and loyalty. You'll also build the trusted data models, evaluation datasets and metric layer that make this measurement possible.
You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, UX, customer service operations and fellow analysts and data engineers.
Location: Hybrid - 3 days a week from our London or Berlin office & 2 days working from home
Reporting to: Manager, Product Analytics

Agentic resolution & AI quality
• Own the scorecard: define, track and report on agentic resolution and customer outcome metrics (e.g. reorder rate, contact propensity, CSAT) across intents and markets.
• Raise the bar on AI quality: build and maintain evaluation frameworks and golden datasets for our AI agents, combining quantitative signals with conversation-level quality reviews.

Experimentation & insight
• Test, learn, repeat: design and analyse experiments on help journeys and the AI chat, from hypothesis and sample size to a clear recommendation.
• Shape the roadmap: turn conversation, ticket and order data into insights that influence Post Order Experience priorities, and present them clearly to PMs and senior stakeholders.

Analytics engineering
• Build the foundations: design clean, well-documented data models (e.g. Kimball) with dbt and SQL for conversation, turn-level, evaluation and ticket data.
• Engineer it properly: apply software engineering practices to analytics, including Git, code review, automated testing and CI/CD.
• Keep data trustworthy: build and maintain reliable pipelines with Airflow and dbt, with data quality checks.
• One source of truth: maintain a governed semantic layer and metric definitions connected to Tableau and/or Looker.

Collaboration
• Break down silos: partner with engineering and data engineering to define tracking and logging (e.g. Snowplow events) for new AI features.
• Move fast with AI: use AI tools in your own workflow to work smarter, and help the team adopt them responsibly.

What will you bring to the table?
• Strong experience as a Product Analyst, Analytics Engineer or in a similar data role, ideally on an e-commerce product.
• Expert-level SQL and hands-on experience building production data models with dbt (or a similar tool).
• Solid understanding of dimensional data modelling, data warehousing and cloud data platforms (e.g. BigQuery / GCP).
• Experience with Git-based workflows, testing and CI/CD for data; experience with Airflow or another orchestrator is a plus.
• Hands-on Python for data analysis and statistics.
• A proven experimentation background: hypothesis formulation, sample size, statistical significance and interpretation.
• Experience building dashboards and semantic layers in Tableau and/or Looker.
• Curiosity about AI products; experience measuring chatbots, conversational AI or LLM output quality is a big plus.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical audiences.
• An ownership mindset.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging
No matter who you are, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. Career site: careers.justeattakeaway.com

jd_full:
Commercial Analyst, Pricing & Proposition (12-month FTC)
Ever looked at a set of numbers and seen the commercial opportunity hiding behind them? If you're someone who enjoys turning data into decisions, this could be the role for you. Reporting to the Proposition & Pricing Director, you'll join us on a 12-month FTC based at 70 St Mary Axe, London, working in a hybrid pattern with three days in the office each week and regular visits across our brands.
At Lomond Group, one of the UK's largest and fastest-growing property services groups, you'll help shape the pricing and proposition decisions that influence performance across our lettings brands. This role sits at the heart of commercial decision-making, turning landlord, property and fee data into recommendations that drive growth, strengthen propositions and help our brands make better-informed decisions with confidence.
What you'll be doing
• Building and maintaining a clear group-wide view of fees across brands, branches and the wider business.
• Identifying pricing opportunities through robust analysis and assessing both commercial value and likelihood of success.
• Modelling pricing changes, promotions and offers to understand break-even points and potential returns.
• Creating evidence-based insight into how pricing influences wins, losses and conversion performance.
• Sizing and evaluating proposition opportunities, including packaged services and new revenue streams.
• Using customer segmentation to help branches target the right landlords with the right propositions.
• Supporting longer-term commercial initiatives through retention, share of wallet and customer behaviour analysis.
• Producing monthly performance reporting on fee changes, service uptake, churn and commercial outcomes.
• Measuring the effectiveness of launches and trials and providing clear recommendations on what works.
• Creating high-quality presentations and papers for senior stakeholders including brand MDs and ExCo, clearly communicating methods, assumptions and recommendations.
What you'll need
• Experience in a commercial, pricing, revenue or insight analyst role.
• Strong SQL skills with the ability to work independently with large transactional datasets.
• Advanced Excel skills, including modelling, scenario planning and sensitivity analysis.
• Strong commercial judgement with the confidence to distinguish meaningful trends from noise.
• The ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to senior stakeholders through reports, presentations and recommendations.
• A detail-oriented approach with a strong focus on data accuracy, validation and reconciliation.
Here's what you can look forward to
• 28 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays
• A pension scheme
• Car Salary Sacrifice Scheme
• Enhanced Family Friendly Leave
• Employee Assistance Programme
• Competitive base pay benchmarked to market, plus commission & performance bonuses on most roles
• Funded professional qualifications
If you'd like to be considered, apply through our careers site. Our recruitment process consists of a first-stage conversation with the TA team followed by a second-stage interview with the Hiring Manager.
The closing date for applications is 16th December 2026.

About Us
URBN UK Limited is part of the URBN Group, a global retailer, with its European Head Office located in London. Its retail offering in Europe takes the form of three brands. With stores in more than 10 European countries and a strong e-commerce presence.

As our Junior Analyst you will support two key business areas: workforce management for our UK/EU retail business and management accounts for our third-party channels (franchise and wholesale).

Financial

• Produce clear commentary and performance reports (monthly and quarterly) for wholesale and franchise management accounts, from top-line revenue to operating income.
• Support the monthly forecasting cadence, including financial model maintenance and system data uploads.
• Support the annual budgeting and long-range planning (LRP) processes across full channel P&Ls.
• Identify opportunities to streamline reporting cycles through continuous process improvement and better use of systems.

Overview
As a Business and Research Analyst, you will be responsible for researching the UK construction market, analysing industry trends and identifying commercial opportunities to support the company's strategic growth and business development objectives.
You will gather, evaluate and interpret market, competitor and commercial information to provide evidence-based insights that inform management decisions. Working closely with senior management and relevant stakeholders, you will monitor developments within the construction sector, identify potential projects and tender opportunities, and prepare comprehensive market intelligence reports to support business planning, competitiveness and sustainable growth.

• Collaborate with management and relevant stakeholders to identify research requirements, assess business needs and translate findings into practical commercial recommendations.
• Recommend opportunities for business diversification, improved competitiveness and sustainable long-term growth within the UK construction sector.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree in Business Management, Business Administration, Economics, Market Research, Project Management or another relevant discipline.
• Demonstrable understanding of business research, market analysis, commercial evaluation and data interpretation.
• Ability to research and analyse industry information, identify market trends and evaluate commercial opportunities.

About the role
In your role as PMO Analyst - HR Transformation Programme you will provide dedicated PMO leadership and support for the HR Transformation Programme, ensuring robust governance, comprehensive planning, accurate reporting, proactive risk management, and effective delivery support. This role is critical to enabling the successful execution of a complex, multi-year, cross-functional programme.

What you will be doing
As part of the Pensions Solutions and Control team you will be responsible for:
• Producing and maintaining core PMO artefacts (including RAIDs, plans, controls, reports, and analysis).
• Providing continuity for agreed programme coordination, reporting and governance activities during periods of Project Manager absence, within delegated authority and established escalation arrangements.
• Demonstrating a pragmatic, can-do attitude, a willingness to dive into the detail when necessary, and a strong sense of teamwork.

Reporting to the project manager on the HR Transformation Programme, this role encompasses:

Governance & Oversight
• Support the programme and its component parts by understanding the sequence of events and their cross-dependencies, enabling impact analysis if milestones move.
• Maintain comprehensive RAID, decision, and change-control logs, with clear owners, target dates, impacts, mitigations, and escalation routes.
• Co-ordinate and facilitate key governance forums, including scheduling, circulation of materials, recording minutes and tracking actions.
• Coordinate programme change requests and support assessment of impacts on scope, schedule, cost, resources, benefits and dependencies.
• Ensure adherence to change control and approval processes, with a clear audit trail for key artefacts and decisions.

Planning, Scheduling & Management Support
• Maintain and monitor the integrated programme plan, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and key milestones.
• Consolidate milestone trackers from individual workstreams into an overall programme view.
• Ensure programme information is accurately captured in the overarching roadmap.
• Coordinate logistics for cross-functional teams, including scheduling and organising meetings and workshops.

Tracking, Reporting & Insights
• Provide accurate and timely programme reporting (status reports, dashboards and executive updates).
• Prepare high-quality management information packs for senior stakeholders.
• Identify, track and manage risks, issues and dependencies, ensuring mitigating plans are in place.
• Proactively follow up on outstanding actions and items.
• Work with Finance business partners to provide regular budget and forecast updates.

Resource Management
• Support programme resource planning and maintain an integrated view of resource requirements, allocations, gaps and constraints.
• Maintain availability and holiday information for the core programme team and flag potential impacts on delivery milestones.

About you
If you're excited about working for us and have most of the skills or experience we're looking for, please apply, regardless of whether you meet all the requirements.
• Proven experience in PMO or programme support roles within complex, multi-year programmes, ideally within HR, technology or other business transformation programmes.

Strategic Data Analyst - Great Ormond Street Hospital Children's Charity
We're looking for a Strategic Data Analyst to join our growing Insight & Performance team. You'll work on projects from forecasting and predictive modelling to supporter lifetime value, audience insight and understanding what drives engagement, helping move beyond reporting what happened to understanding why and what to do next.
We're looking for someone with strong SQL and analytical skills, a curious mind and the ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations.

Salary
£42,700 per annum; hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days per week in the office. Salaries are not offered above the advertised rate.

Key Responsibilities
• Deliver strategic analysis that helps Fundraising and Marketing teams understand performance, identify opportunities and make informed decisions.
• Develop forecasts, predictive models and segmentation approaches to understand supporter behaviour, lifetime value and opportunities for growth.
• Analyse fundraising campaigns and audience performance, identifying trends, risks and opportunities.
• Work with stakeholders across the charity to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
• Use insight to support business planning, investment decisions and prioritisation of fundraising activity.
• Evaluate campaigns and experiments.
• Work closely with Selections, Reporting and Data Engineering colleagues to improve audience targeting.
• Explore new analytical techniques and approaches.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
• Strong SQL skills, with experience analysing and interrogating complex datasets.
• Experience delivering analysis that informs business decisions.
• Experience developing analytical models, forecasts, segmentation or predictive approaches.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience working with CRM data and analytical tools to understand customer, supporter or audience behaviour.
• Experience using data visualisation tools such as Power BI.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• A curious and proactive approach.
• Experience working with fundraising or supporter data.

DBS: a basic DBS check is required.
How to apply: short application form via the apply button. Closing date: 2 December 2026; applications reviewed on an ongoing basis and the role may close early.
Benefits: 30 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, flexible working, enhanced pension, life assurance, health and wellbeing schemes.

Entry-Level | Farnborough | Advisory services

About Us
Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients across every aspect of the built environment, transport and energy to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 23,500 employees across more than 70 countries.
In the UK, we're proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets.
Egis provides comprehensive services to the aviation sector, including advisory, design, engineering, operations, and digital transformation. Operating in more than 100 countries and delivering over 4,000 aviation projects, we partner with airports, air navigation service providers (ANSPs), regulators and governments.

About the Role
We are looking for strategic thinkers who are looking for the opportunity to make a real impact in the aviation industry and build a career as a management consultant supporting Egis' aviation advisory offering. Our clients include airports, ANSPs, governments and regulators, so the project work you do will be varied.

Your responsibilities as a Strategic Analyst would include:
• Providing systematic and structured analysis to our aviation project teams
• Prepare detailed reports, presentations, and visualizations for internal and external stakeholders, summarizing findings and recommendations
• Support the innovation and development of the aviation industry to make it more sustainable, cost-efficient and safe
• Present analysis and recommendations to project teams, clients, and management
• Support our customers in making key business decisions

As our clients are based worldwide, this role will provide you with the opportunity for international travel for face-to-face client interaction.
Sometimes you'll tackle highly analytical assignments; other times, you'll focus on report writing and presentation skills. The consultancy environment can be very fast paced with opportunities emerging at very short notice that will require a flexible, agile approach. We collaborate closely with clients and partners, both at our offices or on client premises.

What do we need from you
Essential
• You are expecting to graduate with a minimum of 2:1 in any of the following subjects: Economics, space, aviation, engineering or another numerate related subject.
• You are good at analysing and presenting data to internal and external stakeholders
• You have excellent report writing skills
• You are a strong communicator
• You are a critical and innovative thinker
• You are equally comfortable collaborating within a team and working autonomously
• You are flexible and adaptable to evolving requirements
• You have strong inter-personal skills
Desirable
• You have a passion for the Aviation industry
• You are able to speak multiple languages

What we can offer you
• Mentorship and career progression opportunities with future global career prospects
• Ongoing learning, access to training and development, including a pathway to professional recognition (e.g., Chartership)
• Competitive salary based on demonstrated skills and experience
• An Employee Assistance Program available to staff, family, and household members

Please upload your cover letter and CV and any other documents that you think will set you apart to our career's portal.
We are an Equal Opportunities employer. Your application will be assessed based purely on your experience, the essential and desirable criteria, and your suitability for the role.

Lloyd's is the world's leading insurance and reinsurance marketplace, bringing together the world's leading risk takers to advance global progress.

Lloyd's are recruiting for an MI Analyst, Member Capital. This is an opportunity to work with the data at the heart of the Lloyd's market. You'll turn complex capital and reserving information into clear, useful insight, helping us understand performance, strengthen our oversight and make better-informed decisions.

What you'll be doing
You'll work across syndicate and member capital, combining data analysis, management information and continuous improvement. You'll:
• Analyse large and complex datasets, identifying trends, outliers and insights that matter
• Help develop and improve management information using tools including Excel, Power Query and Power BI
• Support the processing, validation and audit of capital data submitted through Lloyd's systems
• Build and maintain reporting that tracks capital returns and business forecast submissions
• Develop validation tools and improve how data moves into and out of capital models
• Carry out analysis on member capitalisation and syndicate benchmark capital
• Help answer data and capital-related queries from across the Lloyd's market
• Support the ongoing development of systems used by market participants to assess capital requirements
• Maintain clear documentation, controls and audit information so our processes remain robust
• Collaborate with colleagues across actuarial, risk, catastrophe and syndicate performance teams

What you'll bring
We're interested in what you can do and your potential to develop, not whether you tick every box. You'll ideally bring:
• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large datasets
• Advanced Excel skills, including experience with Power Query
• Experience with analytical or data tools such as SQL Server, R or Databricks, or a good foundation and the appetite to develop further
• The ability to translate detailed analysis into clear information for different audiences
• Excellent attention to detail and a logical approach to solving problems
• Confidence managing your own priorities and delivering accurate work to deadlines
• The ability to collaborate with people across different disciplines and communicate clearly
• You'll be of graduate calibre, ideally with a mathematical, analytical or finance-based background. Other relevant professional qualifications are welcome.

Being inclusive at Lloyd's
We aim to build a diverse, inclusive environment, open and positive about workplace adjustments, with employee networks, mentoring, volunteering opportunities and investment in professional development.
Support with your application or adjustments is available through Lloyd's adjustments service (this does not register your application).

Job Overview
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented analyst to join our Audits and Performance Team.
The team plays an important role in helping the establishment understand its performance, recognise good practice, and identify opportunities for improvement. Working with departments across the prison, the team provides insight and assurance that helps maintain high standards across the establishment.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone with strong analytical skills, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to make a positive impact. The role provides exposure to a broad range of operational areas and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful improvements across the establishment.

About the Role
As an Audit and Performance Analyst, you will support the delivery of the establishment's audit and assurance programme, helping to ensure services are delivered safely, effectively, and in line with required standards.
Working closely with teams across the prison, you will contribute to the monitoring of performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide assurance that key processes are operating as intended.

Main Duties
• Conduct audits, compliance checks, and audit walkarounds across the establishment in accordance with audit schedules and business requirements
• Support the delivery of assurance activities across a range of operational areas, including Visits, Tool Management, Searching, Intelligence, and External Escorts

• Monitor compliance against contractual, statutory, and operational requirements, and support preparations for internal and external inspections

What we are looking for
• Excellent attention to detail and strong analytical skills
• Clear communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships
• The ability to work independently, manage priorities, and exercise sound judgement

Deadline for applications is Wednesday 18th November 2026. Following a sift of applications received we will arrange interviews in due course.

Data & Insights Analyst - Mitie, Northampton
Ref: 108701 | Location: Northampton | Employment: Full time

Job Overview
We are looking for a highly capable and commercially minded Contract Data & Insights Analyst to join our Security Operations team.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in developing the contract's data, reporting and analytical capability. Working across Security Operations and the wider contract, you will transform complex operational data into trusted reporting, meaningful insight and effective decision support.
You will work with a broad range of information covering crime, incidents, fraud, colleague safety, operational performance, resourcing, financial performance and service delivery. A central focus will be ensuring the client and operational teams can have confidence in the accuracy, integrity and consistency of the data and reporting used to make decisions.
The role also offers the opportunity to help shape future capabilities, including greater automation, advanced analytics, forecasting and responsible use of AI-enabled solutions.

Main Duties
• Develop and maintain trusted reporting and management information across the contract
• Validate, reconcile and quality assure key datasets, KPIs, dashboards and reporting outputs
• Ensure reporting uses accurate source data, consistent definitions and clearly documented methodologies
• Identify data-quality issues, investigate root causes and work with stakeholders to improve data capture at source
• Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and visualisations using Power Query and DAX
• Bring together information from multiple systems and data sources to create a consistent view of performance
• Analyse trends, risks, patterns, anomalies and performance issues to support operational and strategic decisions
• Support the development of scalable data models, reporting frameworks and automated validation and reporting processes
• Translate stakeholder requirements into effective analytical solutions and clearly explain the source, definition and limitations of reported information
• Help drive continuous improvement in data governance, reporting, automation and analytical capability

Essential Skills and Experience
• Experience in a data, business intelligence, performance, management information or analytical role
• Experience working with complex datasets from multiple sources and developing effective data models
• Experience of data validation, reconciliation, quality assurance and resolving data discrepancies
• Excellent attention to detail and a demonstrable commitment to data accuracy
• Working knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, data governance and data lineage
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify meaningful trends and exceptions
• Ability to translate complex analysis into concise, actionable insight for technical and non-technical audiences
• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including confidence challenging figures and methodologies where appropriate

Desirable Skills and Experience
• Strong Power BI capability, including Power Query and DAX
• Microsoft Fabric or Microsoft Azure data technologies
• Power Automate, Python, APIs or wider data-integration experience
• ETL, data transformation or data-warehousing knowledge
• Predictive analytics, forecasting, anomaly detection or geospatial analysis
• AI-enabled analytics and automation
• Experience working with crime, security, risk, incident, workforce or operational-performance data

Why This Role Matters
Accuracy and trust in reporting are fundamental to this role. You will help ensure that operational teams, contract leadership and the client can rely on the information used to make important decisions, and help explain why things happened and where action may be required.

Success in the Role
• Accurate, consistent and reliable reporting supported by clear validation controls
• Improved data quality, governance, documentation and traceability
• Meaningful insight that supports operational and strategic decisions
• Reduced manual reporting through controlled and sustainable automation
• Increased client and stakeholder confidence in contract data and reporting

Benefits
• Virtual GP; Salary Finance scheme; flexible benefits platform
• High street discounts, cycle-to-work, life cover up to four times salary
• Enhanced pension, save-as-you-earn, Mitie Matching Share Plan; Mitie Stars awards; training and development

Salary: £28k - £36k (Glassdoor estimate, not employer provided)

Transformation Business Analyst
Permanent
